fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: You are about to enroll as a Governor. This will send a transaction with the required collateral to the governance contract. You can unenroll at any time.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: To stay a Governor you will need to participate in at least 1 vote every 30 days.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: If there is nothing to vote on then you can manually continue your enrollment by sending an active ping.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAI: Your Governor registration status will become visible when your blockchain is fully in sync.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: The Metrix blockchain is undergoing a DGP migration. You will need to unenroll from the old DGP contract and re-enroll in the new one. If you have an old Governor then you will only see an unenroll button on this page.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: New DGP Enrollment will be possible once onchain activation takes place. Our discord will contain the latest info on this.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: The button below will unenroll your old version Governor and return your collateral.
fr.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Once your unenrollment is complete this option will disappear.
fr.DGP.PAGES.BUDGET.TITLE: Budget Proposals
fr.DGP.PAGES.BUDGET.MINIMUMGOVERNORS: Budgets cannot be passed until the minimum number of Governors exist on the chain.
fr.DGP.PAGES.CREATEPROPOSAL.TITLE: Create a Proposal
fr.DGP.PAGES.CREATEPROPOSAL.DESCRIPTION: Below you can create a budget proposal and submit it to the network for voting before the next budget settlement block.
fr.DGP.PAGES.CREATEPROPOSAL.PROPOSALADDRESS: Payment Address (You must own this address)
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.INCOMPLETEFORM: You have not filled in all required fields correctly
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.INVALIDPROPOSALDURATIO: Proposal durations should be between 1 and 12 months
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.CREATEDPROPOSAL: Your proposal has been created successfully
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.ENROLLEDGOVERNOR: Your enrollment will be complete once your transaction is confirmed
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.PINGEDGOVERNOR: Ping sent successfully. Your Governor will be updated once the transaction is confirmed
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.VOTEDONPROPOSAL: Your vote will be counted once the transaction is confirmed.
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.UNENROLLEDGOVERNOR: Transaction sent. Your Governor will be unenrolled once the transaction is confirmed
fr.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.GOVERNORNOTMATURE: Your Governor is not mature enough to perform this action yet

sq.TOKEN.PAGES.LIST.EMPTYDETAIL: Altitude automatically checks a block explorer for MRC20 and MRC721 tokens sent to your addresses, then verifies everything live against your own node. You can also add a token manually if you know its contract address.

sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: You are about to enroll as a Governor. This will send a transaction with the required collateral to the governance contract. You can unenroll at any time.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: To stay a Governor you will need to participate in at least 1 vote every 30 days.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: If there is nothing to vote on then you can manually continue your enrollment by sending an active ping.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAI: Your Governor registration status will become visible when your blockchain is fully in sync.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: The Metrix blockchain is undergoing a DGP migration. You will need to unenroll from the old DGP contract and re-enroll in the new one. If you have an old Governor then you will only see an unenroll button on this page.
sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: New DGP Enrollment will be possible once onchain activation takes place. Our discord will contain the latest info on this.

sq.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Once your unenrollment is complete this option will disappear.

da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: You are about to enroll as a Governor. This will send a transaction with the required collateral to the governance contract. You can unenroll at any time.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: To stay a Governor you will need to participate in at least 1 vote every 30 days.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: If there is nothing to vote on then you can manually continue your enrollment by sending an active ping.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAI: Your Governor registration status will become visible when your blockchain is fully in sync.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: The Metrix blockchain is undergoing a DGP migration. You will need to unenroll from the old DGP contract and re-enroll in the new one. If you have an old Governor then you will only see an unenroll button on this page.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: New DGP Enrollment will be possible once onchain activation takes place. Our discord will contain the latest info on this.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: The button below will unenroll your old version Governor and return your collateral.
da.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Once your unenrollment is complete this option will disappear.
da.DGP.PAGES.BUDGET.TITLE: Budget Proposals

da.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.ENROLLEDGOVERNOR: Your enrollment will be complete once your transaction is confirmed
da.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.PINGEDGOVERNOR: Ping sent successfully. Your Governor will be updated once the transaction is confirmed
da.DGP.NOTIFICATIONS.VOTEDONPROPOSAL: Your vote will be counted once the transaction is confirmed.

ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: You are about to enroll as a Governor. This will send a transaction with the required collateral to the governance contract. You can unenroll at any time.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: To stay a Governor you will need to participate in at least 1 vote every 30 days.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: If there is nothing to vote on then you can manually continue your enrollment by sending an active ping.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAI: Your Governor registration status will become visible when your blockchain is fully in sync.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: The Metrix blockchain is undergoing a DGP migration. You will need to unenroll from the old DGP contract and re-enroll in the new one. If you have an old Governor then you will only see an unenroll button on this page.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: New DGP Enrollment will be possible once onchain activation takes place. Our discord will contain the latest info on this.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: The button below will unenroll your old version Governor and return your collateral.
ig.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Once your unenrollment is complete this option will disappear.

id.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: You can sign messages with your addresses to prove you own them. Be careful not to sign anything vague, as phishing attacks may try to trick you into signing your identity over to them. Only sign fully-detailed statements you agree to.
id.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Enter the signing address, message (ensure you copy line breaks, spaces, tabs, etc. exactly) and signature below to verify the message. Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
id.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.

lo.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: You can sign messages with your addresses to prove you own them. Be careful not to sign anything vague, as phishing attacks may try to trick you into signing your identity over to them. Only sign fully-detailed statements you agree to.
lo.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Enter the signing address, message (ensure you copy line breaks, spaces, tabs, etc. exactly) and signature below to verify the message. Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
lo.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.

mg.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.

Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
mr.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.

pa.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.
pa.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: You are about to enroll as a Governor. This will send a transaction with the required collateral to the governance contract. You can unenroll at any time.

ro.PAGES.STAKING.NOTENABLEDINSTR: To stake you will need to enable staking setting staking=1 in your metrix.conf file.
ro.PAGES.STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINFO: Your wallet is currently locked for staking.
ro.PAGES.STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINSTR: You can start staking by unlocking your wallet for staking
ro.PAGES.MASTERNODES.NOMNOUTPUTS: No Masternode outputs found. To run a local Masternode send exactly 2,5,25,50 or 100 million coins to your Masternode address and wait for 15 confirmations.
ro.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: You can sign messages with your addresses to prove you own them. Be careful not to sign anything vague, as phishing attacks may try to trick you into signing your identity over to them. Only sign fully-detailed statements you agree to.
ro.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Enter the signing address, message (ensure you copy line breaks, spaces, tabs, etc. exactly) and signature below to verify the message. Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
ro.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.

sn.DGP.PAGES.GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Governors are responsible for voting on monthly budgets and blockchain changes. You can become a Governor by locking the correct collateral in the Governance contract.

so.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: You can sign messages with your addresses to prove you own them. Be careful not to sign anything vague, as phishing attacks may try to trick you into signing your identity over to them. Only sign fully-detailed statements you agree to.
so.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Enter the signing address, message (ensure you copy line breaks, spaces, tabs, etc. exactly) and signature below to verify the message. Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
so.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.

uk.PAGES.SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: You can sign messages with your addresses to prove you own them. Be careful not to sign anything vague, as phishing attacks may try to trick you into signing your identity over to them. Only sign fully-detailed statements you agree to.

Be careful not to read more into the signature than what is in the signed message itself, to avoid being tricked by a man-in-the-middle attack.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO:
Welcome to the Metrix Core RPC console.
Type help for an overview of available commands.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: WARNING: Scammers have been active, telling users to type commands here, stealing their wallet contents. Do not use this console without fully understanding the ramification of a command.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: These repair commands cannot be run when Metrix Core is run externally
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.INFO: The buttons below will restart Metrix Core with command-line options to repair the wallet, fix issues with corrupt blockchain files or missing/obsolete transactions.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Attempt to recover private keys from a corrupt wallet.dat.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -rescan: Rescan the blockchain for missing wallet transactions.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Recover transactions from blockchain (keep meta-data, e.g. account owner)
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Upgrade wallet to latest format on startup. (Note: this is NOT an update of the wallet itself!)
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Rebuild blockchain index from current blk000??.dat files.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Downloading Metrix blockchain files from metrixcoin.com and bootstrap your installation. Depending on your network connection this can take 10 minutes to a couple of hours
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Delete your local blockchain files and resync from the genesis block.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Restart Metrix Core if it's already running or start Metrix Core if it isn't running.
uk.PAGES.TOOLS.REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Delete your local Metrix Core and reinstall it from Metrix servers.
